refined.coefficient_interpretation: nonnegative operation costs on branch-specific dependency graphs; no per-shape lookup or total-time correction factor
refined.inference_calibration: immutable artifact; inputs and CPU tiling only; no runtime refitting
refined.metadata_revision: same numerical micro-model extracted as subclasses of the original estimator; parameter values and calibrated graphs unchanged

micro_cost_contract.batch_preload: B IterateBatch: BatchLoad A/B completes before the inner batch MMAD loop. After each output, BatchScheduler sets/waits M_MTE1, so the next MTE1 operation waits for that MMAD output; independent L0 ping-pong does not remove this explicit event.
micro_cost_contract.manual_l1: Varlen L1: MM1 partitions N by 256; MM2 partitions K by 256, accumulates, then GetTensorC. Varlen SameAB L1: MM2 partitions K by 192 and output N by 128.
micro_cost_contract.measurement_reuse: Existing measurements only; four complete S1/S2 group folds; no runtime coefficient fitting, no measured target input to predict, no per-shape latency lookup
micro_cost_contract.microtile_arithmetic: MMAD M/N/K from Matmul loops; real tail dimensions; 16-element compute padding; first K accumulator setup separated from continuation
micro_cost_contract.pipe_cost_context: batch, manual L1, direct SameAB and KFC callers have distinct empirical primitive priors when supported; sparse contexts borrow the matching instruction primitive
micro_cost_contract.pipe_m_barrier: SDK MmadCompute: floor(m/16)*floor(n/16)<10 inserts PIPE_M; m=1 is fixed to 16 for non-GEMV Matmul. Barrier synchronization is scoped to PIPE_M, not a global Scalar/MTE stall; its issue is counted explicitly.
micro_cost_contract.refinement_policy: Refinement candidates are diagnosed by source conditions and sequence-group residual sign tests with FDR correction. No new split is activated merely because a single shape has a large error.
micro_cost_contract.scalar_scope: commands count source API steps, MMAD issue and conditional PIPE_M issue; calibrated useful issue service is bounded by measured Scalar busy including polling
micro_cost_contract.stage_scope: BMM1/Vec1/BMM2/Vec2 critical-path contributions are modeled; normal PMU contains whole-kernel pipe service sums. Independent undisturbed stage wall times remain unavailable.

refined.optimizer_policy: nonnegative operation rates; Scalar PMU upper constraints; source-matched primitive priors; no per-shape lookup or total-time scale factor
refined.qualification: cross-validated source-operation model; accuracy is reported per family and input
